00-handbook-collage: Diserapa tsa permaculture di sebetsa: poone, ditholwana, dibethe tsa serapa tse kwahetsweng ka mulch, lehae le sebetsang ka matla a letsatsi le kotulo ya meroho.
06-food-forest-durban: Food forest ya dibaka tse futhumetseng e bonwang ho tswa hodimo: dibanana, sefate se senyane sa ditholwana, dihlahla le groundcover, ho se na mobu o se nang sekwahelo.
07-swale-dug-by-machine: Swale e telele e tjhekwang ka motjhini, le thupa ya ho metha (survey staff) ho boloka ho lekalekana ho nepahetse.
07-runoff-dam: Letamo la runoff hodimo setsheng le tshwara metsi a phallang ho theosa phula.
07-pond-filled: Letangwana lona leo, le aletsweng ka polasetiki, kamora dibeke tse mmalwa, le tletse kamora pula e matla.
07-sand-dam-lesotho: Letamo la lehlabathe (sand dam) le tshelang noka e phallang ka dihla.
11-stone-house-bethel: Moaho wa majwe le seretse (cob) o nang le diphanele tsa letsatsi le lesoba la moya marulelong: lehae le raletsweng bakeng sa letsatsi.
11-biogas-digester-build: Ho aha biogas digester ya lelapa: tanka e dutse ka hara sekoti se aletsweng ka diblokong.
